title: Zymo Zyppy™-96 Plasmid MagBead Miniprep
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Refill tip racks as needed
steps.instruction: If running a high‑throughput experiment with more than 80 samples, manually refill tip racks during the run.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map for the Zyppy‑96 workflow.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App; consult support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the semi‑automated miniprep for up to 96 samples.
